dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「今日こそは、“ヌー”が置いてあればいいん
　だが」
dialogues.en: "I wonder whether "Nuu" is available today..."
dialogues.text: "I wonder whether "Nuu" is available today..."

dialogues.jp: 深刻な顔で杉並が呟く。
dialogues.en: Suginami muttered with an oddly serious face.
dialogues.text: Suginami muttered with an oddly serious face.

dialogues.jp:
「隔月の雑誌なんだろ？　発売日になれば、普
　通に置いてあるんじゃないのか？」
dialogues.en:
"That's a bi-monthly publication, isn't it? Today's the
release day, so why won't it be available?"
dialogues.text:
"That's a bi-monthly publication, isn't it? Today's the
release day, so why won't it be available?"

dialogues.jp:
雑誌“ヌー”は、杉並のお気に入りのオカルト
雑誌だ。
dialogues.en:
"Nuu" magazine is actually some occult magazine that
Suginami reads regularly.
dialogues.text:
"Nuu" magazine is actually some occult magazine that
Suginami reads regularly.

dialogues.jp:
俺もマンガでも買おうと思って、杉並に付き合っ
ていた。
dialogues.en:
I was at the shopping district to buy some manga, so
Suginami decided to tag along.
dialogues.text:
I was at the shopping district to buy some manga, so
Suginami decided to tag along.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いや、あの雑誌は、休刊というか廃刊の危機
　にさらされているらしくてな。いつお目にか
　かれなくなるか、心配で心配で……」
dialogues.en:
"No, I mean that magazine was recently suspended, and
there's a good chance of it being discontinued entirely.
Worry, worry..."
dialogues.text:
"No, I mean that magazine was recently suspended, and
there's a good chance of it being discontinued entirely.
Worry, worry..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　と、あれは、白河ことりじゃないのか」
dialogues.en: "Hm? Isn't that Shirakawa Kotori?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? Isn't that Shirakawa Kotori?"

dialogues.jp: 商店街の先を見遣り、目を細めた。
dialogues.en:
Focusing my attention on the shopping district, I narrow my
eyes to sharpen my view.
dialogues.text:
Focusing my attention on the shopping district, I narrow my
eyes to sharpen my view.

dialogues.jp:
つられるように目を向けると、ことりらしき人
物が、とある店から出てくるところだった。
dialogues.en:
After a quick once-around, I saw person that looked quite a
bit like Kotori walking out of a store.
dialogues.text:
After a quick once-around, I saw person that looked quite a
bit like Kotori walking out of a store.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「頭痛で早退したって話だったが、何故こんな
　所に？」
dialogues.en:
"She's supposed to be down with a headache, what's she doing
here?"
dialogues.text:
"She's supposed to be down with a headache, what's she doing
here?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……って、お前、何でんな事知ってるの？」
dialogues.en: "....What the, how did you know that?"
dialogues.text: "....What the, how did you know that?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「有名だからな、彼女は。耳が付いてれば、嫌
　でも入ってくる」
dialogues.en:
"She's famous after all. I couldn't have ignored the talk
about her even if I wanted to."
dialogues.text:
"She's famous after all. I couldn't have ignored the talk
about her even if I wanted to."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……そんなもんか？」
dialogues.en: "...There was talk about her?"
dialogues.text: "...There was talk about her?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前は寝てたんだろう」
dialogues.en: "You must've been asleep."
dialogues.text: "You must've been asleep."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「失神してたんだ」
dialogues.en: ""Meditating", I'd like to call it."
dialogues.text: ""Meditating", I'd like to call it."

dialogues.jp:
どう違う？　と問いかけてくる杉並を無視して、
俺は再び前に目を向けた。
dialogues.en:
Wasn't I? Suginami ignored my words though, and I continued
looking at Kotori.
dialogues.text:
Wasn't I? Suginami ignored my words though, and I continued
looking at Kotori.

dialogues.jp: 「せっかくだ。話しかけてみるか」
dialogues.en: "This is stupid. Let's just go talk to her."
dialogues.text: "This is stupid. Let's just go talk to her."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　朝倉？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? Asakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ことり」
dialogues.en: "Kotori!"
dialogues.text: "Kotori!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉君だ。こんちは」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Asakura-kun. Hello!"
dialogues.text: "Ah, Asakura-kun. Hello!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「こんちは」
dialogues.en: "Hey."
dialogues.text: "Hey."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「やあ、どーもどーも。朝倉の友人です。杉並
　です」
dialogues.en:
"Ahem, excuse me! I am a friend of Asakura's. Please call me
Suginami!"
dialogues.text:
"Ahem, excuse me! I am a friend of Asakura's. Please call me
Suginami!"

dialogues.jp:
意外に礼儀正しく、杉並が頭を下げる。ことり
もぺこっと会釈した。
dialogues.en:
With a surprising show of politeness, Suginami bowed his
head. Kotori bowed hers in return.
dialogues.text:
With a surprising show of politeness, Suginami bowed his
head. Kotori bowed hers in return.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「白河ことりです」
dialogues.en: "I'm Shirakawa Kotori."
dialogues.text: "I'm Shirakawa Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「頭痛、大丈夫なのか？」
dialogues.en: "Has your headache gotten better?"
dialogues.text: "Has your headache gotten better?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「はい。少し休んだら良くなったんです。それ
　で、暇だから、外を歩いてたんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"Uh huh. It went off after a bit of sleep. I got a bit
restless after that, so I decided to take a walk."
dialogues.text:
"Uh huh. It went off after a bit of sleep. I got a bit
restless after that, so I decided to take a walk."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そっか。なら、良いんだけどな」
dialogues.en: "I see. That's good then."
dialogues.text: "I see. That's good then."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「心配かけちゃったみたいですね。ごめんなさ
　いです」
dialogues.en: "I must've worried you. I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "I must've worried you. I'm sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ん？　ああ、いやいや、俺は野次馬根性が凄
　いんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Hm? Ahh, no need for that, I'm just a huge busybody."
dialogues.text: "Hm? Ahh, no need for that, I'm just a huge busybody."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そうなのか？」
dialogues.en: "Is that so?"
dialogues.text: "Is that so?"

dialogues.jp:
杉並が素で疑問をぶつけてくる。うるさい奴め。
俺は話の流れを強引に修正した。
dialogues.en:
Shut up and don't try to ask difficult questions like that,
you idiot. I decide to quickly change the topic.
dialogues.text:
Shut up and don't try to ask difficult questions like that,
you idiot. I decide to quickly change the topic.

dialogues.jp:
「そういや今さ、メガネ屋から出てこなかった？
　目、悪いの？」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, just now, you were coming out of the spectacles
shop, weren't you? Is your eyesight bad?"
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, just now, you were coming out of the spectacles
shop, weren't you? Is your eyesight bad?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「自慢じゃないですけど、目がいいのが自慢な
　んです」
dialogues.en: "Not to boast or anything, but I'm proud of my eyesight!"
dialogues.text: "Not to boast or anything, but I'm proud of my eyesight!"

dialogues.jp: ……自慢なのでは？
dialogues.en: ...That's something to be proud of?
dialogues.text: ...That's something to be proud of?

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ちょ、ちょっと、サングラスを見てたんです
　よ」
dialogues.en: "I, I was just looking at some sunglasses."
dialogues.text: "I, I was just looking at some sunglasses."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……サングラス？」
dialogues.en: "...Sunglasses?"
dialogues.text: "...Sunglasses?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「何だか、ああいうのって、不良っぽくていい
　じゃないですか」
dialogues.en: "You know, those kind that look like punks wear them!"
dialogues.text: "You know, those kind that look like punks wear them!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "...Punks wear them?"
dialogues.text: "...Punks wear them?"

dialogues.jp:
何だか、似つかわしくない単語二連発に、思わ
ず首を傾げてしまう。
dialogues.en:
I tilt my head curiously at the thought of a connection
between Kotori and punks.
dialogues.text:
I tilt my head curiously at the thought of a connection
between Kotori and punks.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……冗談ですよ、冗談」
dialogues.en: "...I'm just joking. A joke."
dialogues.text: "...I'm just joking. A joke."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ああ、そう」
dialogues.en: "Ah, ahh, I see..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, ahh, I see..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「だって、私、ゆーとー生さんですから」
dialogues.en: "I guess I won't be much of a comedian!"
dialogues.text: "I guess I won't be much of a comedian!"

dialogues.jp: にこっと笑うと、にぱにぱ手を開閉した。
dialogues.en:
Kotori's face exhibited a laughing smile, opening and
closing her palm.
dialogues.text:
Kotori's face exhibited a laughing smile, opening and
closing her palm.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「それじゃ、私は帰ります。バイバイ。杉並君
　も」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, I'd be heading back now. Bye bye! To you too,
suginami-kun!"
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, I'd be heading back now. Bye bye! To you too,
suginami-kun!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「バイバイ」
dialogues.en: "Bye bye."
dialogues.text: "Bye bye."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「さて、さっさと本屋に行くか」
dialogues.en: "Alright, let's head to the bookshop already."
dialogues.text: "Alright, let's head to the bookshop already."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お？　おう」
dialogues.en: "Oh? Oh, right."
dialogues.text: "Oh? Oh, right."

dialogues.jp:
背中まである髪の毛をぼんやりと見ていたが、
杉並の声に我に返る。
dialogues.en:
I was watching Kotori's back and hair slowly fade into the
distance, when Suginami's voice brought me back to reality.
dialogues.text:
I was watching Kotori's back and hair slowly fade into the
distance, when Suginami's voice brought me back to reality.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「にしても、お前、白河ことりと仲いいのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Besides, when did you and Shirakawa Kotori become so close,
eh?"
dialogues.text:
"Besides, when did you and Shirakawa Kotori become so close,
eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ん〜？　別に。まあ、会っていきなりマウン
　トポジション取り合う程いがみ合ってもいな
　いが」
dialogues.en:
"Hm? Not really. In fact, we crossed swords the first time
we met, and no doubt it'd happen again in the future."
dialogues.text:
"Hm? Not really. In fact, we crossed swords the first time
we met, and no doubt it'd happen again in the future."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ただの病気だろう、それは」
dialogues.en: "Need to see a doctor?"
dialogues.text: "Need to see a doctor?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「まさしくお前だろう、それは」
dialogues.en: "That's how we first met, wasn't it?"
dialogues.text: "That's how we first met, wasn't it?"

dialogues.jp: ババッ！
dialogues.en: PAPAA~!
dialogues.text: PAPAA~!

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ふ……反応速度が上がったな、朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Huu... your reflexes have improved, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Huu... your reflexes have improved, Asakura."

dialogues.jp:
お互いにファイティングポーズをとりながら向
かい合う。
dialogues.en: We faced each other, both in fighting poses.
dialogues.text: We faced each other, both in fighting poses.

dialogues.jp: 「そういうお前もな、杉並」
dialogues.en: "So has yours, Suginami."
dialogues.text: "So has yours, Suginami."

dialogues.jp:
寒空の下、商店街の真っ直中で、奇異の視線を
集めてしまう俺達であった……。
dialogues.en:
In the cold weather, right smack dab in the middle of the
shopping district, several pairs of curious eyes were
staring at us...
dialogues.text:
In the cold weather, right smack dab in the middle of the
shopping district, several pairs of curious eyes were
staring at us...

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりとサングラス◆
dialogues.en: ◆Kotori and Sunglasses◆
dialogues.text: ◆Kotori and Sunglasses◆

dialogues.jp:
商店街を杉並と一緒にぶらついていると、こと
りを見かけた。
dialogues.en:
While walking down the shopping district with Suginami, we
saw Kotori on the way.
dialogues.text:
While walking down the shopping district with Suginami, we
saw Kotori on the way.

dialogues.jp:
頭痛で早退したはずだったが、調子が良くなっ
たので、散歩しているとの事だった。
dialogues.en:
After some rest, she had recovered from her headache, and
was taking a walk.
dialogues.text:
After some rest, she had recovered from her headache, and
was taking a walk.

dialogues.jp:
ことりはメガネの店から出てきたのだが、ほん
とにサングラスに興味があるのかね……。
dialogues.en:
We had seen her emerge from the spectacles store, apparently
she was quite interested in sunglasses...
dialogues.text:
We had seen her emerge from the spectacles store, apparently
she was quite interested in sunglasses...
